raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Keep prompt groups isolated in the V1 `ReplayBuffer` when a UID contains underscores.

Trajectory keys are `{uid}_{session_id}_{index}`, but the replay buffer recovers the UID with `key.split("_")[0]`. A UID such as `math_00017` maps to `math`. Its trajectories are then missed by sampling (sync mode raises "selected terminal groups with no materializable trajectories"), by DAPO reward classification, by failed-group detection and by clearing. UIDs that share a prefix can also be mixed or cleared together. The default trainer generates UUID4 UIDs (hyphens only), so default runs are not affected. The problem appears with custom or dataset-provided UIDs.

This PR parses the UID from the fixed suffixes (`key.rsplit("_", 2)[0]`) everywhere the buffer maps trajectory keys to groups.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: [replay buffer uid](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+replay+buffer+uid), [replay_buffer underscore](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+replay_buffer+underscore). I also checked every open PR that touches `verl/trainer/ppo/v1/replay_buffer.py`:
  - #8203 (draft, BREAKING) replaces `replay_buffer.py` with a `StreamingDataloader` actor and already parses keys with `rsplit("_", 2)` there. This PR is a minimal fix for the current `ReplayBuffer` on `main`. If #8203 lands first, this PR can be closed.
  - #6874 adds a session marker but keeps the same left split, so its parser will need to be reconciled whichever lands first.
  - #6868 and #7415 change dispatch and storage backends, not key parsing.
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`.

### Test

Run from the repository root on CPU (Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.13, TransferQueue 0.1.11) with a local Ray cluster:

```bash
RAY_ENABLE_UV_RUN_RUNTIME_ENV=0 PYTHONPATH=. python -m pytest tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_replay_buffer_on_cpu.py -q
```

- With this PR: `54 passed`.
- The same test file against current `main`: `8 failed, 46 passed`.

The tests use real Ray and TransferQueue. They cover clearing groups with shared prefixes, sampling and DAPO reward classification for underscored UIDs, multiple trajectory indices, sync and async materialization, and failed-group detection.

### API and Usage Example

No API change. The key format `{uid}_{session_id}_{index}` is unchanged. The docstring now states that UIDs may contain underscores.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/trainer/ppo/v1/replay_buffer.py`: new `_trajectory_uid()` helper replaces the seven `key.split("_")[0]` call sites.
- `tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_replay_buffer_on_cpu.py`: regressions with underscored and shared-prefix UIDs.

AI assistance (OpenAI Codex and Cursor) was used to write the code, tests and this description. This is a draft: the submitter is reviewing every changed line and will mark it ready after that review.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply pre-commit checks: `pre-commit run --files <changed files>` passed all hooks.
- [x] Add / Update the documentation: no user-facing change beyond the docstring.
- [x] Add unit tests: `tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_replay_buffer_on_cpu.py` is collected by `cpu_unit_tests.yml`.
- [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in the `ci-request` channel.
- [x] Not related to the `recipe` submodule.
